tonight.headline: Tuten is still in your lineup — Gordon to RB, Diggs to FLEX
body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten is ruled out (ankle/foot) and is still sitting in your RB slot at 06:50 CDMX. ESPN has now zeroed him, so the lineup as set projects 111.3. Warren finished with 5.6 in Pittsburgh's 27-5 win (20 carries for 46), so you have 9.1 banked against Footballers' 61.4. ESPN gives you 15%.
One move, before 12:00 Sunday: Ollie Gordon II from FLEX to RB, Stefon Diggs from the bench into FLEX, Tuten to the bench. It is worth 12.7 points, and nothing else on this roster needs touching.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Footballers have 25.3 from Caleb Williams, 19.6 from Emmett Johnson and 16.5 from Christian Watson banked. Still to play: Smith-Njigba (21.7), Nabers (16.6), Bowers (15.2) and Hampton (12.8). With the swap made, ESPN reads about 100 to 144.

case.label: Their soft spots
case.body: Justin Herbert is out (concussion), so DJ Uiagalelei makes his first NFL start for the Chargers (Yahoo; NFL.com Week 12 report). That touches their Hampton and Dicker. Bowers missed Friday's practice and is questionable for Sunday night; Kubiak: 'We're doing everything we can to get him ready' (ABC7 27 Nov 23:39). Footballers have Chris Rodriguez Jr. (15.7) on their bench and can still start him.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing you control beyond the swap. The gap is about 44 projected points. If Bowers is inactive Sunday night, that is roughly 15 off their side, which is still not enough on its own.

doFirst.title: Tuten is out: Gordon to RB, Diggs to FLEX
doFirst.subtitle: Still not made at 06:50 CDMX. Bench Tuten, slide Gordon into RB and start Diggs in FLEX.

case.label: The ruling
case.body: Jacksonville ruled Tuten out (ankle/foot) on Friday after three missed practices (NFL.com Week 12 report; CBS 27 Nov 22:11Z). ESPN has now zeroed his projection. In Friday afternoon's file it still read 18.7. Chris Rodriguez Jr. is 'slated to operate as the Jaguars' top backfield option' (CBS). He is on Footballers' bench.

case.label: The move
case.body: Ollie Gordon II (14.0) slides from FLEX to RB, and Stefon Diggs (12.7, WSH at ARI, Sun 15:25) takes FLEX. Diggs over Travis Etienne Jr. (12.0) is a 0.7 gap: a coin flip, taken by projection, with no thesis. Jakobi Meyers (14.1, free agent) would be 1.4 over Diggs, also inside the line, and adding him costs Etienne. Not worth a roster move.

case.label: Who throws to Diggs
case.body: Jayden Daniels, who practised in full Wednesday, Thursday and Friday (left elbow/hand) with no game designation. Diggs was on Wednesday's report for personal reasons and came off it Thursday (SI Commanders final report, 27 Nov). The 'Diggs out' headline in search results is that Wednesday line.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Etienne outscores Diggs (archive). That grades the coin flip, not the move. Or the RB/FLEX seat scores zero because the swap was not made.
